About Jayaswal Neco Industries Limited
JAYASWAL NECO INDUSTRIES LIMITED, is a Public Listed Company incorporated in the year 1972 and engaged in the business of Iron & Steel. As per the latest available financials filed by the company for the year Mar 2026, the total paid-up capital is INR 9,710 million and Authorized capital is INR 25,000 million. The last Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the company was held on 10 September, 2025 and the company has filed their last balance sheet for the period ending on Mar 2026.

The registered office address of this company is F-8 Midc Industrial Area, Hingna Road, Nagpur, Maharashtra - 440016, Email: contact@necoindia.com.

As per the records, the Auditor(s) of the company : Charurvedi & Shah - Mumbai(Statutory), Manisha & Associates - Nagpur(Cost Auditor), R A Daga & Co-Nagpur(Secretarial Audit)
